title: Customer-Placed Renewal Orders for Tailwise Pharmacy DEA-Prescriber Classes
content:
*Customer hand-over card, Tailwise Pharmacy.*

## Scope

This Tailwise Pharmacy policy sets the days' supply per fill that a renewal order asks the veterinarian for when the customer renews a prescription whose class requires a DEA-registered prescriber and that has reached refills exhausted or expired. Such a class is never renewed by the pharmacy on its own, so the customer places the renewal order personally. The renewed prescription is the prescription the renewal names as the one it renews.

## When the days' supply is fixed

The days' supply per fill a renewal order asks for is fixed only after every dispensed fill of the renewed prescription that carries a dispensing-error claim also carries a refund entry on the pharmacy ledger.

Put as a reading of the records: while the pharmacy ledger of the renewed prescription shows a dispensed fill with a dispensing-error claim and no refund entry against that fill, the days' supply per fill of the renewal order is not yet fixed.

## Invocation

The renewal order is placed with the customer's own tool `place_rx_renewal_order_580a75e8`. The agent unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the prescription owner, as returned by the customer lookup | reference number |
| `pet_id` | the pet profile reference number of the patient, as returned by the pet lookup and shown on the renewed prescription | reference number |
| `vet_id` | the reference number of the veterinarian the renewal is addressed to, as shown on the renewed prescription and returned by the veterinarian lookup | reference number |
| `medication` | the medication name exactly as written on the renewed prescription returned by the prescription lookup | verbatim: copied character for character with no change of wording, spelling or punctuation |
| `strength` | the strength exactly as written on the renewed prescription returned by the prescription lookup | verbatim: digits, units and punctuation unchanged |
| `renewal_of_rx_id` | the prescription reference number of the renewed prescription being renewed, as returned by the prescription lookup | reference number |
| `days_supply_per_fill` | the days' supply each fill of the renewal is to contain | whole number of days, at least 1 |
| `quantity_per_fill` | the packages dispensed in each fill of the renewal | whole number of packages, at least 1 |

## Return

On success the tool returns `rx_prescription_id` (reference number of the new renewal prescription), `renewal_of_rx_id` (the renewed prescription), `medication`, `strength`, `days_supply_per_fill` (days), `quantity_per_fill` (packages), `ordered_on` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (`pending_vet_authorization` once the order is placed).

## Observable effect

One call opens a new prescription for the same pet, medication and strength, marked as the renewal of the prescription being renewed and waiting for the veterinarian's authorization. It carries the renewed prescription's class, package item number and current package price, with the days' supply per fill and the packages per fill given in the call, ordered today. The customer can then see the new prescription pending veterinarian authorization with no fills authorized yet; the renewed prescription is left exactly as it was.
